metricNotes.latency: HTTP duration in ms; end-to-end wall metrics provided per operation
metricNotes.rps: global k6 rate; segment RPS = observed request count / scheduled completed plateau seconds
metricNotes.cpu: Host % across 24 logical CPUs; Docker and generator % relative to one CPU; interval averages, not instantaneous peaks
metricNotes.missing: null or empty CSV cells mean unavailable; never zero-filled
metricNotes.duration: No request-level time series; plateau schedule and crossing counters prove completion, not exact per-VU occupancy at every instant
metricNotes.thresholds: Legacy export boolean false = satisfied (!threshold.ok); independently recomputed from metric values
